phase_name: Cross-session fixture tests for both hooks

objectives.description: Update every existing subagent-postflight.sh case with cc_session_id
Add events-log-lifecycle.sh cross-session + no-match companion cases
Run full file, confirm pass count rose (9 -> 20)

deviations.description: Update every existing subagent-postflight.sh case so its marker carries a cc_session_id and its payload carries the matching session_id
deviations.reason: Cases (c) and (e) test the malformed-marker path specifically. Under the new correlation-first find_marker(), a malformed marker's cc_session_id is structurally unreadable and can never match any CC_SESSION_ID, so it can never be selected as MARKER_FILE -- this hook's old diagnosable parse-failure block reason for a malformed marker is gone by design, not by omission. Rather than force a cc_session_id onto a marker whose entire point is to be unparseable, these two cases were rewritten to assert the new, correct fail-safe behavior ({} stdout, marker/loop-guard left byte-identical) and the comment block explains the semantic shift plus the pointer to where malformed-marker observability now lives (events-log-lifecycle.sh's malformed_postflight_marker deviation event).
deviations.annotation: *(completed: cases (c) and (e), which test the malformed-marker path, were revised rather than merely re-parameterised -- a malformed marker's cc_session_id is structurally unreadable so find_marker() can never select it; their assertions now check the fail-safe {} plus byte-identical marker/loop-guard survival)*
